stem:
Harsh prepares a natural indicator by boiling red rose petals in water. He adds a few drops of the extract to lemon juice and the mixture turns pink. He adds a few drops to soap solution and the mixture turns green.

What do these colour changes show?

options.text: Lemon juice is basic and soap solution is acidic.
Lemon juice is acidic and soap solution is basic.
Both lemon juice and soap solution are acidic.
Both lemon juice and soap solution are basic.

teacher.key_rationale: With this rose extract, pink marks an acidic sample and green marks a basic sample, so lemon juice is acidic and soap solution is basic.
